name: Mozey Extracts 510 Cartridge | Pineapple Diesel
description: Pineapple Diesel has a strong diesel aroma with citrus undertones. This energizing sativa flavor is a mix of gasoline and tart pineapple. Comprised of D - limonene, alpha - pinene, beta - caryophyllene, myrcene, and linalool terpenes
